text.trigger: A player has a non-exiled survivor outside the colony, Gabriel Diaz is in the survivor deck, and the colony has room for a survivor.
text.vignette: Smoke fills the little room faster than you expected, and the window will not budge. When you come to, strangers are carrying you outside: a broad man, his wife, and three small children watching you with enormous eyes.

options.show-them-the-way: Tell them about the colony: Gabriel Diaz leaves the survivor deck and joins your following, and 3 helpless survivors are added at the colony.
options.repay-them: Thank them with a gift and part ways: choose 1 card from your hand and remove it from the game.
